answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates a ledge of trust, forcing agents to map virtual identities to physical human nodes. To reach the summit of network security, the system utilizes willow-based cryptographic primitives to verify uniqueness without exposing private data. An attacker must incur the high capital cost of acquiring verifiable human signatures for every puppet identity, rendering large-scale automated proliferation economically prohibitive for malicious actors.
